3. Learned State counsel per his instructions from ASI Naveen submits that petitioner has joined investigation and in view of cooperation rendered by him, no custodial interrogation of petitioner is required.
4. In view of the above, since custodial interrogation of petitioner is no more required and he has already joined investigation and cooperated with the investigating officer, present petition is allowed.
